note: Issue 436, natives.md section 11. A governor below neutral and above the floor answers a tribe himself and tells the PC afterwards, naming the answer he gave. One letter per answer, because a line cannot be chosen by a condition. Placeholder prose.

body.text: The {param:tribe} wrote to me about what {param:town} was doing on their ground.
I have sent them something for their trouble, and the town carries on as it was.
I did not think the matter would keep for a letter to you and back.

options.text: sorry you did not write to me first
